title: Hi, I'm Imad
copy: Designer, developer and photographer based in Huddersfield. I make things that look good and work well.

whatIDo.label: What I do
whatIDo.value: I specialise in front-end development, branding, and product and food photography. When I'm not coding or designing, you'll usually find me out with my camera or having a play around with new tech.

whatDrivesMe.label: What drives me
whatDrivesMe.value: My approach to design and development is simple: if something looks good and works well, people are more likely to use it. The easier a product is to use, the more people it can reach. Every project teaches me something new, and that's what keeps me motivated.

currently.label: Currently
currently.value: Web Developer at Richer Sounds, building e-commerce frontend by day. Always keen to chat about new projects or opportunities.
